title: Mitochondria in life, death and disease
about: EMBO|FEBS course "Mitochondria in life, death and disease" takes place in Landshut, Germany, from 13 to 17 September 2027, for students and postdoctoral researchers. Registration and abstract submission close on 4 June 2027.
card_alt: Card for "Mitochondria in life, death and disease" by EMBO, held in Landshut, Germany, deadline 4 Jun 2027. The photo shows the Cologne Cathedral and Hohenzollern Bridge (a representative image of Germany, not the event venue).
